title: Mechanical Design Engineer - Rehabilitation Robotics (MVP to Product)
description:
About Anthera Dynamics -
  
  
Anthera Dynamics is a deep-tech startup on a mission to make rehabilitation robotics affordable and accessible, so neuro and ortho patients can regain their independence. We build rehabilitation robots that help people walk and move again. We are backed by Nikhil Kamath's WTFund, ARTPARK at IISc Bangalore, NSRCEL at IIM Bangalore, and the AssisTech Foundation (ATF). Our robots have been validated in the lab and at few hospitals. Now we are turning them into market-ready medical devices that hospitals and clinics can rely on every day. That is where you come in. Learn more at : antheradynamics.com
  
  
  
Role Description -
  
  
This is a full-time, on-site role at ARTPARK, IISc Bangalore. You will be our lead mechanical engineer. You will take a working prototype and turn it into a robust, manufacturable product built for 5+ years of daily clinical use. You will own the mechanical side end to end: CAD, simulation, drawings, vendors, assembly, testing and final documentation. Every important design decision has to be backed by numbers. When a regulator such as CDSCO or the FDA asks why we chose a particular material or wall thickness, you will have the simulation results and test data to answer them. This is a startup, and we are a small team. You will wear many hats. One day you might run a buckling analysis, the next you might be at a vendor's shop floor fixing a weld or assembling a unit by hand. If that sounds exciting rather than exhausting, keep reading.
  
  
  
Role Responsibilities -
  
  
Design and product engineering
  
• Own the complete mechanical design of our robots, from individual parts to the full assembly
  
• Redesign prototype parts so they can be manufactured repeatably, at scale and within cost
  
• Select materials, fasteners, bearings, transmissions and standard parts, and justify every choice
  
• Think at the assembly level: tolerance stack-ups, serviceability, cable routing, ease of assembly, cleaning and patient safety
  
  
Simulation and design justification (core of the role)
  
• Run and interpret FEA, including:
  
– Static stress analysis
  
– Nonlinear static stress analysis (contact, large deformation, nonlinear materials)
  
– Event simulation (impact, drop and other dynamic loads)
  
– Buckling analysis
  
– Fatigue and long-term bending, deflection and creep analysis across the product's life
  
– Modal / vibration analysis
  
• Choose and justify part thicknesses, materials and safety factors with clear numbers
  
• Write clean, traceable simulation reports that hold up in a regulatory review
  
• Plan physical tests to back up the simulations (load tests, cycle tests, tip-over and stability tests)
  
  
Manufacturing and vendors
  
• Design for manufacturing and assembly (DFM/DFA) across CNC machining, sheet metal, welding, injection moulding, casting and 3D printing
  
• Find, brief and manage fabrication vendors; review quotes; check first articles; fix production problems
  
• Build and maintain BOMs, and drive cost down without giving up reliability
  
• Take part in hands-on assembly, testing and design iterations in our lab
  
  
Documentation and regulatory support
  
• Make production-ready 2D drawings with correct GD&T
  
• Maintain design history: drawings, revisions, change records, verification reports and test results
  
• Support our quality and regulatory work (design controls, risk management, verification and validation) for CDSCO, FDA and ISO submissions
  
  
  
Must-Have Skills -
  
  
• B.E./B.Tech or M.E./M.Tech in Mechanical Engineering or a related field
  
• Hands-on experience taking at least one product from prototype to production release
  
• Expert in SolidWorks and/or Fusion 360, including large assemblies
  
• Strong practical FEA skills: static, nonlinear static, event/dynamic, buckling and fatigue simulations, and you can tell when a result is wrong
  
• Strong machine design fundamentals: stress, deflection, fatigue, joints, fasteners, bearings, shafts, gears and linkages
  
• Deep knowledge of manufacturing processes: CNC machining, sheet metal, welding, injection moulding, casting, 3D printing (FDM, SLA, SLS/MJF) and surface finishes (anodising, powder coating, plating)
  
• Production-grade drawings with GD&T, plus tolerance stack-up analysis
  
• Clear technical writing: you can explain a design decision in a report that someone else can audit
  
  
  
Good to Have Skills -
  
  
• Experience with medical devices or other regulated products
  
• Familiarity with ISO 13485 (design controls), ISO 14971 (risk management) and IEC 60601-1 (mechanical safety, stability, mechanical strength)
  
• Knowledge of biocompatibility considerations (ISO 10993) for patient-contact parts
  
• Experience with robotics, actuators, motor mounting, transmissions or mechatronic systems
  
• Experience with ANSYS, Abaqus, SolidWorks Simulation or Fusion 360 Simulation
  
• Experience with physical testing: strain gauges, load cells, cycle and endurance tests
  
• Bonus points if you were part of a robotics club, SAE, Formula Student or similar competition team in college
  
  
  
Who we are looking for -
  
  
• Energetic, self-driven and comfortable owning outcomes with little supervision
  
• Comfortable switching between simulation, CAD, the shop floor and documentation in the same week
  
• You care about why a design works, not only that it works
  
• You enjoy building things that directly improve people's lives
  
  
  
Why Join us -
  
  
• Own the entire mechanical design of a medical robot, with no layers of approval in between
  
• Work at ARTPARK, IISc Bangalore, one of India's top robotics ecosystems
  
• See your work help real patients walk and move again
  
• Be at the bleeding edge of advanced rehabilitation robotics
  
  
  
Preferences -
  
  
Apply with a resume that includes a short portfolio (3 to 5 pages) showing:
  
1. A product or assembly you took to production
  
2. A sample simulation (FEA) report or results you produced
  
3. Photos or drawings of parts you designed and got manufactured
  
  
Applications that include a portfolio will be reviewed first.

title: Founding Simulation Engineer
description:
Robotics is at an exciting junction. Deployments are picking up pace, and so is the number of ways these robots can fail. Incredible progress lands every day, and every step forward uncovers hundreds of new problems. There has never been a better time to enter the field.

That's why we're looking for a founding simulation engineer to join us. You'll own large parts of our Real2Sim2Real pipelines from day one, working directly with customers and real hardware. This is an early role with a lot of ownership: you decide how the pipeline is built and validated.

**What you'll work on:**

* Hands-on simulation, calibration and system identification. Build and calibrate sensor and actuator models, tune contact and dynamics against measurements from the physical system, and fit simulation parameters from real data.
* Understanding the solvers beneath the models and finding ways to improve them.
* Metrics and validation methods that measure the sim2real gap, and improving on them.
* Modeling complex environments and assets in simulation, including articulated and deformable assets where the customer's task needs them.
* Pipelines around simulation for data generation, evaluation and continual improvement.

**Who You Are:**

* You've got your hands dirty building robots, both in real life and in sim, and you know the pain of transferring policies from sim to real.
* You've taken something from idea to a working system on real hardware or real data, not only a prototype.
* You have high agency and high integrity, and you're willing to learn, apply and fail quickly.
* You take complete ownership with minimal guidance and do everything possible to make the product work.
* It doesn't matter if you don't have experience in every requirement, as long as you have a strong interest to learn and apply quickly.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with at least one of Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, Genesis, or any other multiphysics solver.
* Strong coding skills, and fluency with AI coding agents and agentic workflows to build, test and iterate quickly.
* ROS2 and other robotics middleware stacks.
* 3D reconstruction techniques, such as Gaussian splatting.

**How We Hire:**

* A take-home assignment, followed by technical and culture-fit interviews.

**How To Apply:**

Send us a link to something that you have built and are proud of, along with your CV, to careers@trekion.ai.

Education and Experience

Soft Skills

* Proficiency in English for both written and spoken communication.
* Detail-oriented with robust organizational and problem-solving abilities.

Pharma manufacturing is one of the last large industries still running on paper, Excel, and tribal knowledge. A single missed step in a batch record can mean a recall, a regulatory warning, or a drug that should never have left the plant.

Leucine is the AI platform replacing all of it. Series A, backed by top-tier global investors, 60+ pharma enterprises in production, and the team that's going to define this category.

**What You'll Do**

* Tackle founder-level problems. Dive into ambiguous questions (e.g., "How do we cut customer onboarding time by 40%?") and deliver a data-backed solution—process, product spec, or growth playbook

* Love messy problems. You run towards the smoke, disassemble chaos into first-principles, then rebuild in clean layers of logic & data

* Have a bias for action. You'd rather ship v0.1 today and iterate than debate v2.0 for weeks
* Communicate like an engineer and a poet. Precision when the stakes are technical; story when hearts & budgets are on the line
* Are hungry—really hungry. Titles don't impress you; impact does. You measure weeks in learnings shipped
* Bring 1-5 years of high-intensity experience. Early-stage start-up, tier-one consulting, I-banking, ops in manufacturing—anything that shows you can out-execute peers

**Requirements**

**Must-Haves**

* 1-4 years of experience in start-up, consulting, business operations, product, or manufacturing.
* Engineering background from tier 1 / tier 2 colleges
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent Excel/Google Sheets and presentation skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* High ownership, bias for action, and comfort with ambiguity.
* Ability to work cross-functionally across GTM, Product, Operations, and CS.

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Experience working with founders/CXOs or on strategic projects.
* Background in B2B SaaS, manufacturing, pharma/lifesciences, or enterprise tech.
* Experience with SQL, dashboards, automation, or process building.

**Benefits**

* Be part of a fast-growing SaaS company transforming the future of pharmaceutical manufacturing through cutting-edge technology
* Collaborate with a passionate, high-performing team building innovative AI-powered digital solutions
* Take ownership of impactful client implementations from day one, with ample opportunities for learning, career growth, and professional development
* Enjoy a competitive compensation package designed to reward your contributions

description:
**About The Team**
The Information Security organization helps protect Walmart’s customers, associates, information assets, and technology environment. SOC Incident Management is a centralized security operations function responsible for monitoring, detecting, analyzing, investigating, escalating, and responding to security threats. Analysts work alongside security engineers, incident responders, threat intelligence teams, and other cybersecurity professionals to protect the organization’s information assets and networks.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Security Monitoring, Investigation & Incident Response
  
  
Monitor, triage, analyze, investigate, and support remediation of cyber events using defined SOC procedures, playbooks, escalation paths, and service expectations.
  
  
Perform investigation across endpoint, network, email, identity, cloud, Windows, and Linux telemetry; correlate evidence across multiple data sources to determine scope, impact, root cause, and recommended actions.
  
  
Run approved commands, queries, scripts, and automation for assigned areas of work while maintaining appropriate operational controls and documentation.
  
  
Identify indicators of compromise, suspicious behaviors, attack patterns, and emerging risks; escalate confirmed or high-risk incidents to the appropriate response teams.
  
  
Communicate clearly with technical and business stakeholders during troubleshooting and security events, providing timely status, findings, risk context, and recommended next steps.
  
  
Monitor & track KPIs such as MTTA, MTTR
  
  
Detection Engineering & Continuous Improvement
  
  
Provide actionable input to improve alert logic, correlation rules, detection use cases, thresholds, enrichment, prioritization, and suppression of known false positives.
  
  
Identify opportunities for new risk detection based on investigation trends, threat intelligence, recurring incidents, control gaps, and observed attacker behavior.
  
  
Partner with engineering and platform teams to validate and operationalize detection improvements across SIEM, EDR, SOAR, email security, firewall, IPS, and cloud security tooling.
  
  
Capture investigation learnings, recurring patterns, root causes, and operational gaps; recommend measurable improvements to SOC processes, playbooks, documentation, and analyst workflows.
  
  
AI / Generative AI Responsibilities
  
  
Use approved AI/GenAI capabilities (for example, Copilot, ChatGPT, Gemini, or enterprise-approved equivalents) to assist with investigation summarization, evidence correlation, query/script drafting, threat-context synthesis, case documentation, and recommendation generation.
  
  
Critically validate AI-generated analysis against authoritative telemetry and security evidence before using it for incident decisions, escalation, remediation, or stakeholder communication. Maintain analyst accountability for final conclusions.
  
  
Assess the quality of AI-assisted investigations by identifying inaccurate conclusions, missed evidence, weak reasoning, hallucinations, incomplete recommendations, or inconsistent outputs, and provide structured feedback for improvement.

Identify appropriate opportunities to integrate AI/GenAI with SIEM, SOAR, EDR, threat intelligence, case-management, and knowledge-management workflows to reduce repetitive analyst effort and accelerate triage and investigation.
  
  
Apply responsible-AI and security principles when using AI tools, including data handling, confidentiality, access controls, human oversight, traceability, and compliance with company policies and approved-use requirements.
  
  
Monitor AI-assisted workflows for quality and operational risk, and escalate cases where AI output could create false assurance, inappropriate remediation, data exposure, or other security impact.
  
  
Contribute to AI readiness across the SOC by documenting effective practices, sharing lessons learned, and supporting analyst adoption and training for approved AI-enabled capabilities.
  
  
Cybersecurity Technology & Solution Support
  
  
Support cybersecurity intelligence and security-operations solutions by gathering requirements, researching technologies, participating in solution reviews, and contributing to supplier/product evaluations.
  
  
Develop and review system, process, investigation, and operational documentation to support consistent execution and knowledge transfer.
  
  
Maintain current knowledge of cybersecurity threats, attacker techniques, security technologies, automation, and AI/GenAI developments relevant to SOC operations.
  
  
**What You'll Bring**
Collaboration, Documentation & Stakeholder Management
  
  
Participate in team assignments and projects, provide timely progress updates, contribute to team meetings and technical discussions, and support cross-functional initiatives.
  
  
Create and review high-quality case notes, standard operating procedures, playbooks, knowledge articles, metrics, reports, and presentations for management, technical teams, customers, suppliers, and other stakeholder
  
  
Build collaborative relationships across functional and organizational boundaries and respond effectively to stakeholder and business-unit requests.
  
  
Governance, Ethics & Compliance
  
  
In accordance with company policies, security standards, procedures, ethical expectations, and applicable compliance requirements.
  
  
Protect sensitive information throughout investigations and communications, using approved systems and appropriate data-handling practices.
  
  
Demonstrate professional judgment, fact-based decision-making, transparency, and appropriate escalation when evidence is incomplete or risk is uncertain.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**
B.E./B.Tech/M.S./M.Tech/MCA or equivalent technical qualification, with approximately 6–9 years of relevant SOC/cybersecurity operations experience.
  
  
Hands-on experience with EDR and SIEM technologies across on-premises and cloud environments; Azure Sentinel/Microsoft Sentinel and Google Chronicle experience is desirable.
  
  
Experience with SOAR, email security, incident/case management, firewall, IPS, security correlation, detection use-case development, and deployment.
  
  
Hands-on cybersecurity investigation skills including malware analysis, phishing/email analysis, network and endpoint investigation, and Windows/Linux operating-system analysis.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
Practical exposure to AI/GenAI tools such as Copilot, ChatGPT, and Gemini, with the ability to use them responsibly and critically in cybersecurity workflows.

title: Vulnerability Management Lead
description:
**Job Title: Vulnerability Management Analyst**

**Location**
:
**Remote (India)**

**Full Time**

**Job Summary**

DXC’s Global Cyber Security team is building a more mature, comprehensive approach to cyber risk management across the company. As frontier AI models and autonomous AI agents accelerate both vulnerability discovery and exploitation, our analysts play a central role in finding, validating, and driving the remediation of weaknesses before attackers exploit them. Vulnerability Management Analysts work across external attack surface management, software security, infrastructure and network, and patching, applying AI-driven tools to keep pace with the speed and volume of modern threats.

You will work closely with the Vulnerability Management Lead, AI Security Engineers, security architects, cloud and infrastructure teams, application development teams, and threat intelligence analysts. The role is hands-on and suits a motivated individual contributor who is curious about AI, comfortable working with data, and committed to closing exposure quickly.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Operate AI-enabled vulnerability discovery and analysis tools, including frontier model-assisted triage, to identify and validate vulnerabilities across infrastructure, applications, and cloud environments.
* Manage external attack surface management activities, including discovering internet-facing assets, shadow IT, exposed services, and misconfigured domains, certificates, and cloud resources.
* Monitor and assess AI agent-related attack vectors, such as prompt injection, insecure tool integrations, exposed agent endpoints, and over-permissioned AI service accounts, and document findings for remediation.
* Perform and coordinate vulnerability assessments of software, including SAST, DAST, SCA, and container and dependency scanning results, and work with development teams to validate and prioritize fixes.
* Analyze infrastructure and network vulnerabilities across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments, and identify exposure paths that increase business risk.
* Manage the patching lifecycle for assigned environments, tracking vendor advisories, prioritizing based on exploitability and asset criticality, and verifying that patches are applied and effective.
* Triage and enrich findings with threat intelligence, known exploited vulnerability data, and asset context, so that remediation teams receive clear, prioritized, and actionable tickets.
* Validate remediations through rescanning and retesting, and confirm closure before findings are marked resolved.
* Track exceptions, risk acceptances, and compensating controls, and maintain accurate records for audit and reporting.
* Build and maintain dashboards and reports on vulnerability posture, patch compliance, aging, and remediation performance for technical teams and leadership.
* Automate repetitive analysis and ticketing tasks using scripts, workflows, or AI-assisted tools, and report on the accuracy and value of automation.
* Document procedures, runbooks, and knowledge articles, and contribute to process improvements for the vulnerability management team.
* Communicate findings and remediation guidance clearly to system owners, developers, and business stakeholders.

**Skills and Attributes for Success**

* Working knowledge of vulnerability management tools and scanners, such as Tenable, Qualys, or Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management.
* Understanding of attack surface management concepts and tools, including asset discovery, DNS and certificate analysis, and internet exposure assessment.

description:
**Description**
Come build the future with us! In Payments Security (PaySec), we protect the foundational systems and products that allow Amazon to accept payments for all goods, content, and services that people buy at Amazon and around the world. International Emerging Stores Payments (IESP) brings Amazon's payments products to customers in some of the fastest-growing markets in the world, across the Middle East and North Africa (MENA), Asia Pacific (APAC) including India, and South America. These markets run on real-time payment rails such as UPI, on local wallets, cards, bill payments, and lending products, and on regulatory regimes that differ from one country to the next. Every one of those transactions depends on customer trust, and IESP Payments Security exists to earn and keep it.
  
  
Payments Security owns full-stack Product Security for Payments across Amazon and its business units. We are part of Amazon's broader Stores Security organization, responsible for protecting Amazon's global information assets. We partner with Payments builder teams to make applications and infrastructure secure-by-design from concept to launch and into continuous operations, and we build the mechanisms, guardrails, and automation that let thousands of engineers do the right thing by default.
  
  
As a software engineer on IESP Payments Security, you will build the software that makes security automatic for Amazon's payments businesses in MENA, APAC including India, and South America. Imagine writing the code that stops a vulnerability before it is merged, or an AI agent that scans hundreds of production applications and finds payment data stored where it should not be.
  
  
You will work on three kinds of problems. First, controls-as-code: security rules and guardrails that run on every code change, including code written with AI assistance. Second, detection agents: AI-assisted services that find sensitive data, vulnerable patterns, and risky configurations across production. Third, onboarding acquired stacks: tooling that brings newly acquired businesses onto Amazon's standard engineering and security platforms. You will work side by side with security engineers, and your work will show up directly in fewer vulnerabilities and less time builders spend fixing them.
  
  
You will own features and components end to end, from design through operation, and help mentor newer engineers.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design, build, test, deploy, and operate secure, highly available services that handle sensitive payments data.
* Build controls-as-code and code-creation security rules that catch common vulnerability patterns before code is merged.
* Build AI-assisted detection agents that find sensitive payment data and vulnerable code patterns across production applications, with high precision.
* Build tooling that onboards acquired businesses' code, cloud accounts, and pipelines onto Amazon's standard security tooling.
* Build automated remediation that proposes or writes the fix for a finding, not just flags it, so builders spend minutes instead of days.
* Meet directly with security engineers and service teams to understand their requirements, and design solutions that make them more productive.
* Estimate engineering effort, plan implementation, and roll out changes that meet requirements for performance, scalability, and reliability.
* Work with security engineers to turn threat models and findings into automated mechanisms.
* Contribute to operational excellence through code reviews, testing, monitoring, and on-call.
* Mentor other engineers and interns on the team.

A day in the life
  
  
You will spend most of your time building: designing services, writing and reviewing code, and shipping. You will pair with security engineers who bring a threat model or a class of findings, and together you will decide what can be automated and how to measure that it works. You will meet the service teams who use our tools, hear where security slows them down, and fix it. The team runs regular architecture reviews and knowledge shares, and you will learn security from people who do it every day.
  
  
**About The Team**
IESP Payments Security is a single-threaded Business Security Team for all of International Emerging Stores Payments. We are security engineers, technical program managers, and software engineers working as one team. We own security for regulated payments and lending businesses, for acquired companies joining Amazon, and for new markets as they launch. We believe security scales through mechanisms and automation, not headcount. As AI writes more of the code our builders ship, we move security into the moment code is created and replace episodic reviews with continuous assurance. We invest in each other's growth as much as we invest in protecting our customers.

* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

description:
Ozyn.AI is an AI assistant that works across people’s email, calendar, documents and messages, and takes actions on their behalf. People will only let an assistant into their lives if they trust it completely. Your job is to make Ozyn worth that trust.

**About the role**

**You’ll be our first security hire, working directly with the CEO and the engineering team. You won’t be writing policies from the sidelines. You’ll review code, change the architecture, build the protections, and own security and privacy for Ozyn end to end.**

**What you’ll do**

* **Secure the agent:**
  design defences against prompt injection, unsafe tool use and data leakage, so that content in a user’s email or documents can never make Ozyn act against them.
* **Protect connected accounts:**
  own how OAuth tokens and permissions for Gmail, Google Calendar, Outlook and other integrations are requested, stored, scoped, rotated and revoked.
* **Keep user data separate:**
  guarantee one user’s data can never reach another user, across databases, caches, vector stores, logs and model prompts.
* **Encrypt and minimise:**
  set up encryption at rest and in transit, key management and secrets handling. Keep personal data out of places it doesn’t need to be.
* **Build privacy into the product:**
  data minimisation, retention and deletion, consent, and handling users’ requests to see or delete their data, in line with India’s DPDP Act and global norms.
* **Review and test:**
  threat-model new features, review pull requests, run security testing, and set up security checks in CI/CD.
* **Detect and respond:**
  set up logging, monitoring and alerting, an audit trail of every action the agent takes, and an incident response plan.
* **Prepare for enterprise buyers:**
  lead our path to SOC 2 or ISO 27001 and answer customer security questionnaires.
* **Raise the bar:**
  teach the engineering team secure defaults so security doesn’t depend on one person.

**What we’re looking for**

* 4–8 years in application, cloud or product security, with real hands-on engineering. You can read and write production code.
* Experience securing a product that handles sensitive personal data, ideally as an early or sole security owner at a startup.
* Strong grasp of OAuth, identity and access management, cloud security (AWS or GCP), secrets and key management, and secure architecture.
* Practical understanding of how LLM applications fail: prompt injection, unsafe tool calling, data leakage through context and logs.
* Sound judgement: you know which risks matter now and which can wait, and you can explain trade-offs clearly to founders and engineers.

**Bonus**

* Bug bounty findings, published security advisories, talks, write-ups or open-source security tools.
* Experience taking a company through SOC 2 or ISO 27001.
* Familiarity with India’s DPDP Act, GDPR or similar privacy rules.

**Why join**

* Define security for an AI assistant from day one, as the person responsible for it.
* Work directly with the CEO in a small, fast-moving team.
* Grow into leading security as Ozyn scales.

description:
Marketing & Sales — Commercial Real Estate & Coworking

Bengaluru · Full-time · ₹30,000 a month plus uncapped performance incentive

Languages required: English, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu and Hindi — all five.

ABOUT 78FLEX

78flex is Kinetic Blume's marketplace for flexible workspace in India. A company tells us what it needs: twelve desks near Indiranagar from January, a meeting room on Thursdays, and we match it to real inventory it can book directly. Operators list their space with us; we earn a commission on what gets booked.

WHERE WE ACTUALLY ARE

In Bengaluru we have thirteen live, bookable spaces from ten operators: the west belt around Nagarabhavi, Papareddypalya and the ORR, two in Whitefield, and single spaces in Indiranagar, MG Road, JP Nagar, Hebbal near Manyata, Amrutahalli, Sarjapur–Marathahalli and Hennur. We have nothing in Koramangala, HSR Layout, Residency Road or Jayanagar. Outside Bengaluru, we have three spaces in Ahmedabad and nothing listed in Hyderabad or Pune, where a customer enquiry is sourced by hand today.

We are still pre-revenue. Bookings have been attempted on the platform, but not one has yet produced commission. You would be the first salesperson here, writing the playbook rather than following one — which is why your first month carries no revenue target.

WHAT YOU WOULD DO

• Create your own demand. Outbound sequences, LinkedIn, target lists, broker and community networks, startup events, business-park outreach, referral loops. This is the marketing half, and it is yours.

• Build what you sell with. The one-pager, the proposal and quote template, the pitch you take into the room.

• Find companies that need space. Startups, growing teams, corporates opening a satellite office.

• Qualify properly. How many people, which locality, what date, what budget, who signs.

• Close the deal with the operator in the room, and make sure we are actually paid.

• Bring in operators where we are short. Koramangala and HSR above all.

• Keep the CRM honest. Your incentive is calculated from it.

• Brief the marketing side. Which localities people ask for, which prices stop a conversation.

WHERE THIS ROLE STOPS

We also have a Marketing Intern. You own the demand you create by hand — outbound, events, referrals, your sales material. They own the demand that arrives on its own — the website and locality pages, search, Google Ads, Instagram and X, Google Business Profiles, analytics. You brief them; you do not do their job.

YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS

Month 1 — Training and pipeline development. No collection target.

Month 2 — First revenue month. Collection target ₹50,000.

Month 3 — Steady state. Collection target ₹1,00,000.

Month 4 onward — Steady state, subject to review. Collection target ₹1,00,000.

Targets are revised afterwards based on market potential, conversion rates, lead availability and your own performance. Any change is agreed with you in writing before it applies.

HOW YOU GET PAID

₹30,000 a month whatever happens, plus a monthly incentive on the eligible net brokerage actually received by 78flex — excluding GST, refunds and third-party pass-through collections.

Your rate for the month is set by how far you get against that month's collection target. That rate then applies to what you collected, with company-generated and self-generated leads calculated separately.

Incentive rates by monthly target achievement:

• Below 50% of target — 0% on company-generated leads, 0% on self-generated leads

• 50% to 99% — 4% on company-generated, 8% on self-generated

• 100% to 149% — 6% on company-generated, 12% on self-generated

• 150% to 199% — 8% on company-generated, 15% on self-generated

• 200% and above — 10% on company-generated, 20% on self-generated

Worked examples against the ₹1,00,000 target, all self-generated:

• Collect ₹40,000 — that is 40%, below the threshold — you earn ₹0

• Collect ₹70,000 — that is 70%, so 8% — you earn ₹5,600

• Collect ₹1,00,000 — that is 100%, so 12% — you earn ₹12,000

• Collect ₹1,50,000 — that is 150%, so 15% — you earn ₹22,500

• Collect ₹2,00,000 — that is 200%, so 20% — you earn ₹40,000

A mixed month: you collect ₹1,20,000 — ₹80,000 self-generated and ₹40,000 from our leads. That is 120% of target, so the rate comes off the 100–149% band: ₹80,000 at 12% plus ₹40,000 at 6%, which is ₹12,000. With salary, ₹42,000 for the month. There is no ceiling.

To be eligible, all of these must hold:

1. The lead was entered into the CRM before it was worked on.

2. The source of the lead is documented — that decides which rate applies.

3. The brokerage has actually been received by 78flex or Kinetic Blume.

4. Cancellation and refund conditions are satisfied. If a deal reverses, the incentive reverses and is deducted from the next payout.

5. The claim is verifiable in the CRM and in our financial records.

6. Adjustments and payments follow the written policy and applicable labour law. Incentive is paid monthly, with the following month's salary.

If you leave, brokerage already collected is paid to you; pipeline is not. And never quote a rate we have not issued in writing.

HOW YOUR PERFORMANCE IS MEASURED

• 70% — Revenue generated and collected

• 20% — Qualified leads and pipeline built

• 10% — New operators signed and inventory added

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• You understand licence vs lease, lock-in, notice, deposit, fit-out, managed office vs private cabin vs hot desk — and why an operator cares about occupancy.

• You have closed something with a real sales cycle: weeks, not minutes.

• You can make your own pipeline from nothing — a target list, a sequence, a reason for someone to reply.

• You are comfortable carrying a target. Most of your upside sits above 100%.

• You know Bengaluru from having been there, not from a map.

• Your CRM would be current if we opened it right now.

• You can do deal arithmetic in your head.

• All five languages: English, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu and Hindi. Four of five with the fifth genuinely in progress? Tell us and we will still talk.

Not required: RERA registration, a big-brokerage background, or a particular degree.

HOW WE HIRE

A 20-minute screening call, then a short task on a real enquiry, then a conversation with the founding team, then a written offer and an employment contract with the incentive plan attached as a schedule.

HOW TO APPLY

Email lrampalli@kineticblume.com with your CV and three or four sentences on the best deal you have closed. Use the subject line "Marketing & Sales — Bengaluru". We reply to everyone who applies, including the people we do not take forward.

title: AI Software Engineer (Hybrid)
description:
**Job Title**
AI Software Engineer (Hybrid)
  
  
**Job Description**
As an AI Software Engineer, your primary responsibility will be to design, orchestrate, and optimise AI-assisted software delivery workflows. Rather than focusing on manual software development, you will engineer systems where AI agents contribute directly to implementation, testing, optimisation, and operational activities under human supervision and governance.
  
  
You will work within a small, high-performing AI Engineering Pod alongside AI Product Owners and Quality Engineers to rapidly deliver business outcomes through AI-native engineering practices.
  
  
The role combines software engineering, AI orchestration, automation, and lightweight platform engineering to enable faster, more adaptive, and increasingly automated delivery approaches.
  
  
You will leverage Generative AI tools, orchestration frameworks, and modern cloud platforms to accelerate delivery while maintaining engineering quality, security, and operational reliability. The pod operates with rapid iteration cycles, lightweight governance, and a strong focus on measurable business outcomes over traditional delivery artifacts.
  
  
**Detailed Responsibilities**
AI-Orchestrated Engineering
  
  

* Design and orchestrate AI-assisted workflows for software implementation, testing, deployment, and operational automation.
* Leverage Generative AI tooling to accelerate engineering delivery, infrastructure automation, and operational activities.
* Build lightweight services, APIs, orchestration layers, and integrations that support AI-native delivery workflows.
* Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic retrieval, and contextual AI capabilities where appropriate.
* Continuously refine prompts, orchestration patterns, and workflow performance to improve reliability, quality, and delivery efficiency.
* Troubleshoot and optimise AI workflows when outputs become inconsistent, unreliable, or operationally ineffective.

AI-Native Delivery & Automation
  
  

* Build and optimise AI-assisted CI/CD pipelines, deployment workflows, and automated engineering processes.
* Implement automated validation, testing, and evaluation capabilities for AI-generated outputs.
* Drive automation-first engineering practices across development, deployment, and operational workflows.
* Leverage AI tooling to accelerate infrastructure-as-code, configuration generation, and operational scripting.
* Deliver containerised and deployable solutions aligned with enterprise cloud and operational standards.
* Ensure observability, traceability, and logging are embedded across AI workflows and services.

Engineering Standards & Governance
  
  

* Ensure solutions align with enterprise security, architecture, and compliance standards.
* Establish reusable orchestration patterns, engineering standards, and implementation approaches for AI-assisted delivery.
* Design modular, maintainable, and composable solutions that minimise unnecessary complexity.
* Support secure AI engineering practices, including prompt safety, data handling, and output validation.
* Ensure delivered solutions are operationally supportable with appropriate documentation and monitoring.

Collaboration & Delivery
  
  

* Collaborate closely with the AI Product Owner to translate business intent into executable AI-assisted workflows.
* Work alongside the AI Quality & Evaluation Engineer to improve testing strategies, evaluation frameworks, and operational confidence.
* Engage with cloud, platform, architecture, security, and operational teams where required to support delivery outcomes.
* Participate in rapid iteration cycles focused on experimentation, validation, and measurable business outcomes.
* Share learnings, reusable patterns, and best practices across the wider engineering organization.
* Contribute to the ongoing evolution of the AI Engineering Pod operating model.

Operational Performance & Risk Management
  
  

* Monitor workflow performance, operational reliability, cost, and delivery effectiveness.
* Identify and mitigate risks relating to scalability, security, reliability, and operational sustainability.
* Support vulnerability remediation, operational improvements, and secure delivery practices.
* Continuously identify opportunities to increase automation and reduce manual engineering effort.

Your current or recent roles may include:
  
  

* Technical Lead
* Full Stack Software Developer
* DevOps Engineer
* Platform Engineer

You are a strong software engineer who is comfortable working in environments where AI systems form part of the delivery process. You understand how to combine
  
  
engineering judgement with AI tools to design, build, and operate reliable software systems.
  
  
You are motivated by solving complex technical problems through automation, orchestration, and iterative system design, rather than manual implementation alone.
  
  
**You Are Able To**

* Understand the strengths and limitations of AI-generated outputs and guide them toward reliable, production-ready outcomes
* Work effectively in fast-moving, experimental environments where solutions evolve through iteration rather than upfront specification
* Balance speed of delivery with engineering quality, security, and operational reliability
* Operate with a high degree of autonomy while collaborating closely with product, architecture, quality, testing, and operations colleagues
* Continuously learn and adapt as AI tooling and engineering practices evolve

**Skills & Experience**

description:
**About Glean**
Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.
  
  
At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.
  
  
Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.
  
  
If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.
  
  
**About The Role**
Glean is seeking a Salesforce Developer to design, develop, and continuously improve our Salesforce platform and its ecosystem of integrations. You will partner closely with Sales, Finance, Operations, and Engineering to build scalable, secure, and reliable solutions that support the full quote-to-cash and go-to-market lifecycle.
  
  
This role is ideal for an experienced hands-on developer who can translate complex business requirements into maintainable Salesforce solutions, independently own technical delivery, and help establish strong engineering, testing, and release practices as Glean scales.
  
  
**You Will**

* Drive the technical implementation of Salesforce enhancements, from technical design and development through testing, deployment support, documentation, and post-release issue resolution.
* Design and develop scalable solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, Salesforce Flow, validation rules, asynchronous processing, and platform automation.
* Build and maintain integrations between Salesforce and internal and third-party systems using REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, middleware, and integration patterns appropriate to the use case.
* Contribute to the evolution of Salesforce as the system of record for opportunity, quote, order, customer, and other go-to-market data.
* Support quote-to-cash capabilities, including Revenue Cloud or CPQ-related processes, product and pricing workflows, order management, approvals, and downstream fulfillment integrations.
* Translate business requirements into clear technical designs, data models, user experiences, and implementation plans.
* Establish and maintain high standards for code quality, test coverage, security, performance, observability, and long-term maintainability.
* Follow and contribute to deployment and release practices across environments, including source control, CI/CD, code reviews, release planning, and rollback readiness.
* Investigate production issues, lead root-cause analysis, and implement durable fixes that prevent recurrence.
* Partner with administrators, analysts, architects, and business stakeholders to balance speed, usability, technical debt, and platform governance.
* Contribute to Salesforce architecture, integration standards, documentation, and operating procedures as the platform and team grow.
* Collaborate with administrators, developers, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable solutions and continuously improve the platform.

**About You**

* 7+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience, including ownership of complex implementations in a fast-growing or enterprise environment.
* Strong proficiency in Apex, Lightning Web Components, Salesforce Flow, SOQL/SOSL, asynchronous Apex, and Salesforce platform capabilities.
* Experience designing and implementing integrations using REST and SOAP APIs, authentication patterns, middleware, platform events, or comparable event-driven approaches.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce data modeling, sharing and security, governor limits, bulkification, performance optimization, and enterprise architecture principles.
* Experience with Sales Cloud and at least one of Revenue Cloud, CPQ, order management, billing, or other quote-to-cash capabilities.
* Experience with Salesforce DevOps practices, source-driven development, Git, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and structured release management.
* Demonstrated ability to convert ambiguous business problems into practical, scalable technical solutions.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders across multiple functions.
* A track record of taking ownership, exercising sound judgment, and delivering reliable solutions in a changing environment.
* Experience working in an Agile delivery environment, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and independently driving technical delivery.
* Salesforce Platform Developer I and II certifications are preferred; additional architecture, integration, or Revenue Cloud certifications are a plus.
* An AI-first mindset and curiosity about using AI-enabled tools to improve analysis, development productivity, testing, documentation, and operational workflows.

**Location:**

* This role is hybrid (3 days a week in our Bangalore office).

**Compensation & Benefits**
Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.
  
  
We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused.
  
  
We’re committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.

At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work.
